title: Affine-open base case for perfect Hom continuity
statement: Let $I$ be a preordered set, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram, $c$ a cocone, $i\in I$, and $s:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$ a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme]. Assume the scheme derived categories of [def-pc-derived-category] exist. In addition, suppose $I$ is directed, $c$ is colimiting, and $s$ is locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. For every affine open $U\subseteq X$, the condition $\mathcal C(U)$ of [def-pc-perfect-hom-continuity-on] holds.

proof.text: For an open-immersion presentation t:Y to X of U, Y is isomorphic to the affine scheme U, hence affine. Unfold PerfectHomContinuityOn and apply the affine perfect Hom presentation to each perfect pair on Y. This supplies bounded finite-projective module complexes and the two compatible Hom equivalences, without assuming continuity.
Apply affine_perfect_hom_colimit to the supplied ring diagram and models. Its bijectivity, followed by injectivity and surjectivity of e, gives bijectivity of colimit.desc H d.

For a limit morphism, lift its inverse image under limit to colimit H and represent it at a stage j by the filtered-set representative lemma. Choose a common upper bound of j and the requested j0. The cocone equation and hlimit show its image is the original morphism.

For two morphisms with equal limit images, hlimit and the injectivity of limit and colimit.desc make their representatives equal in colimit H. The filtered-set equality criterion gives equality at a common stage k. Since the index is a preorder its two arrows from j are equal. For every l above k, apply H(j to l)=H(k to l) composed with H(j to k) to the equality, then use hstage and the stage equivalences to obtain the required perfectStageMap equality.
